import numpy as np
def equation(t,P,params):
    p=params
    f=p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**3+p[4]/(1+P)
    g=1+p[5]*t+p[6]*t**2
    return f*g + p[7]*P*t + p[8]*P**2*t + p[9]*t
